# PT track color palette — ground truth

Index → RGB for Pro Tools track colors, recovered by sweeping every
palette index 0..=255 through the official PT→Reaper converter and
reading back the emitted PEAKCOL (47-track unanimous agreement per index).
Encoded as `PT_TRACK_PALETTE` in `daw-reaper/src/project_import.rs`.

idx 0/1 = Reaper default (no color). Indices 24..47 are the bright/vivid
row; all other indices are darker variants (the 24-wide hue pattern repeats).
